headline: Executive order sets duties for federal agencies to protect migratory birds.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Clinton, lays out responsibilities that federal agencies have for protecting migratory birds. Only the title was available, so the specific steps agencies must take are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are given responsibilities to protect migratory birds when carrying out their work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 10, 2001; the exact effective date is not stated in the source provided.
